motions.motion: take the agenda items out of order and next address item 3, approval of the minutes prior to discussing the remaining agenda items

recommend approval of the preliminary PUD Plat amending a portion of the Holladay Highlands #2, Holladay Highlands No. 5, previously titled “The Upper Place” at 5424 South 2900 East and defer final plat approval to staff. Approval was subject to the following: Findings: 1. The plan provides for three single-family lots each measuring greater than the minimum 10,000 square feet, meeting the R-1-10 lot size requirements. 2. The new additional lots can be serviced by all utilities. 3. The Natural Hazard Study and Summary of Fault Mitigation Measures have been reviewed and accepted by staff. Conditions: 1. A fault study shall be conducted as per Holladay Ord. 13.75.060. 2. All slopes greater the 30% may not be counted toward the minimum required area of Lot 3. 3. All utility service letters shall be submitted. 4. Staff shall renotice the matter and invite more public comment at the time of preliminary approval. 5. The placement of mailboxes shall be studied further in coordination with Public Works Director, Tosh Kano, and Wasatch Front Recycling to see if there are City of Holladay Planning Commission Meeting - 02/04/2020 3 some solutions to help mitigate the impact of 16 to 20 garbage cans at the end of the street. 6. The state of 2900 East shall be studied as a private road to ensure that the service is adequate and meets the standards. 7. Special emphasis shall be placed on the GeoStrata report provided in the summary on page 7
